What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows users to automate tasks across Google products and external services. In the context of digital commerce, it enables seamless integration between payment gateways, order management systems, and content delivery networks. This automation is crucial for creators looking to sell digital products while ensuring that transactions and product deliveries occur smoothly without the need for traditional payment processors that may be unavailable or unreliable.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this automation is the webhook pipeline, which serves as a communication channel between payment processors like NOWPayments and your fulfillment system. When a payment is confirmed on-chain, the webhook triggers an event that initiates the order fulfillment process. Utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can handle these events efficiently. With Cloudflare Workers capable of managing up to 100,000 webhook events daily on the free tier, your infrastructure can scale effortlessly to meet demand.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. By leveraging Google Apps Script and a sovereign stack, these creators can regain control over their payment processing and product delivery systems. This approach not only empowers creators to operate independently but also enables them to provide their customers with a seamless purchasing experience, reinforcing trust and loyalty.
Google Apps Script can automate your entire order fulfillment process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this automation include Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for payment processing. Each component plays a critical role in ensuring that orders are processed promptly and accurately. For instance, after a customer completes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook sends a notification to your backend, which then retrieves the order details from Supabase or Google Sheets and triggers the delivery of digital products, such as ebooks or software.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this automation, start by configuring your Google Apps Script to handle incoming webhook requests from NOWPayments. Next, set up Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data securely. Finally, integrate your chosen file delivery method, such as Google Drive, to ensure customers receive their products instantly. For an easier deployment process, consider using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which is designed for creators and includes everything you need to get started.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
Cloudflare Workers can handle up to 100,000 webhook events daily for free.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery occurs when a payment is confirmed via a webhook from NOWPayments. This triggers your backend to fetch order details and deliver the purchased product automatically, ensuring instant access for the customer.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a lightweight API that allows one system to send real-time data to another. In this context, when a payment is confirmed, NOWPayments uses a webhook to notify your backend, which then processes the order and delivers the product.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, you can automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirmation. By utilizing Google Apps Script, you can set up your backend to trigger an email with the download link as soon as the payment webhook is received.
What is Cloudflare Workers and how can it help my automation?

Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that allows you to run JavaScript code at the edge of the network. It can handle incoming webhook events and process them quickly, ensuring that your digital commerce automation remains responsive and efficient.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered securely?

To ensure secure delivery of your digital products, use a combination of secure storage solutions like Google Drive and authentication methods in your backend to verify purchases before providing download links to customers.
